data: Microsoft reported diluted earnings per share of $9.68 for fiscal 2023 (year ended June 30, 2023), compared with $9.65 for fiscal 2022, an increase of about 0.3%. The small rise reflects the fact that net income was nearly flat year over year, helped slightly by a lower share count. Net income for fiscal 2023 was $72.4 billion, versus $72.7 billion in fiscal 2022, a decline of roughly 0.5%. Note that fiscal 2023 results included a $1.2 billion charge in the second quarter related to severance, hardware impairment and lease consolidation costs, which weighed on earnings growth. These figures are from my recollection of Microsoft's reported results rather than a live lookup, so verify against the company's 10-K if you need them for anything formal.
